capabilities.name: Self-improvement lifecycle
capabilities.summary: Tracks an adopted product improvement through review, runtime QA, installation, and guarded activation.
constraints: Requires an adopted plan and validated lifecycle evidence.
limitations: The active readiness probe validates lifecycle invariants, not host-wide readiness.

capabilities.name: Project specification planning
capabilities.summary: Maintains a project specification and routes unresolved questions through planning conversations.
constraints: Changes are persisted to the configured planning repository.
limitations: This catalog does not inspect a user's planning repository.

capabilities.name: Task board and conversations
capabilities.summary: Organizes TaskIntent-based implementation work and task-specific conversations in a project workspace.
constraints: Task identity and workspace ownership are validated by the application.
limitations: Available actions depend on task lifecycle state.

capabilities.name: Manager opportunity discovery
capabilities.summary: Reviews bounded evidence to suggest project or product improvement opportunities.
constraints: Role and evidence validation constrain the Manager output.
limitations: Provider availability and supplied evidence affect results.

capabilities.name: Repository runtime QA
capabilities.summary: Runs configured build, test, or runtime checks for supported repository targets.
constraints: Requires a compatible configured driver and its dependencies.
limitations: A catalog match does not confirm Docker or host readiness.

capabilities.name: Workspace and repository management
capabilities.summary: Maintains workspace state and references to managed code repositories.
constraints: Repository targets are resolved through the managed workspace state.
limitations: This catalog does not report the user's configured repositories.

capabilities.name: Questions and decisions
capabilities.summary: Tracks specification questions and decisions as structured planning state.
constraints: Decisions are scoped to the selected workspace and specification.
limitations: Provider responses require application validation before mutation.

capabilities.name: Planner and reviewer role workflows
capabilities.summary: Runs structured planning and review roles with role-specific evidence and validated outputs.
constraints: Role payloads and outputs are validated at application boundaries.
limitations: Provider availability and task evidence constrain each run.
providerPrerequisites: Selected role provider installed, authenticated, and available

capabilities.name: Provider routing and role isolation
capabilities.summary: Routes application roles through configured providers and constrained execution profiles.
constraints: Provider-specific policy and role boundaries are enforced by the application.
limitations: Provider presence does not establish authentication or live availability.
providerPrerequisites: Selected CLI provider installed, authenticated, and available

capabilities.name: Git branch and pull request workflows
capabilities.summary: Supports application Git operations and code change integration workflows.
constraints: Operations require a readable repository and configured Git environment.
limitations: Remote authentication and hosting permissions are environment-specific.

capabilities.name: Docker execution
capabilities.summary: Runs configured repository work in Docker-backed execution environments.
constraints: Requires a compatible Docker runtime and approved execution configuration.
limitations: A build does not prove the host has a reachable Docker daemon.

capabilities.name: Code review and repair
capabilities.summary: Collects code review findings and routes supported repair dispositions through task workflows.
constraints: Review actions are bound to current typed findings and task state.
limitations: Human review may still be required by repository policy.

capabilities.name: Local operational storage
capabilities.summary: Persists workspace runtime state and operational metadata through application storage.
constraints: Private task and operational data remain local to the workspace.
limitations: This catalog contains no user-specific storage contents.

capabilities.name: Product documentation and opportunity scan
capabilities.summary: Uses designated public product documentation for isolated Kool.ad/e product opportunity discovery.
constraints: The product scan receives public evidence and an app-owned empty working directory.
limitations: It cannot inspect private workspace or target project evidence.

capabilities.name: Revision-aware repository knowledge
capabilities.summary: Builds a local revision-pinned architecture profile from repository evidence.
limitations: This capability is not implemented by the current build.

capabilities.name: Shared multiuser task service
capabilities.summary: A hosted shared task service coordinating private task state across users.
limitations: The product does not provide this hosted service or shared private task store.
